# Creating Directory
```{r}
plots_dir <- paste(dir_list$plots, "Manuscript_Plots", sep = "/")
dir.create(plots_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

# Setting levels
```{r}
sample_name_map_new <- setNames(metadata$sample_id_new, metadata$sample_id)
```


# Bulk RNA Data
## PCA Plot - based on the top 500 protein-coding genes
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(plots_dir, "Bulk_RNA_PCA_plot", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 8 
plot_width <- 12 

rna_pca <- assay(rna_counts_rlog) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(row_var = matrixStats::rowVars(as.matrix(.))) %>%  
  slice_max(row_var, n = 500) %>% 
  select(-row_var) %>% 
  t() %>% 
  prcomp(., center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

percentVar <- round(100 * (rna_pca$sdev^2 / sum(rna_pca$sdev^2))[1:2])

rna_pca <- as.data.frame(rna_pca$x) %>% 
  mutate(sample_id = rownames(.)) %>% 
  inner_join(metadata, by = "sample_id")

rna_pca %>% 
  ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2, color = cell_type, label = sample_id_new)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = sample_id_new), size = 10/2.845, box.padding = 0.5, max.overlaps = 100) + 
  labs(x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance"),
       y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance"),
       shape = "Cell Culture",
       color = "Donor") +
  theme_light() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11))

ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "svg", sep = "."), device = "svg", width = plot_width, height = plot_height)
ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "png", sep = "."), device = "png", width = plot_width, height = plot_height, dpi = 320, limitsize = FALSE, bg = "white")
```

## Mean Plot
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(plots_dir, "Bulk_RNAseq_DPSC_iN_Mean_plot", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 7
plot_width <- 7

plot_data <- rna_exp_norm %>% 
  mutate(log2_mean_iN = rowMeans(across(ends_with("_iN"), ~log2(. + 1))), 
         log2_mean_Native = rowMeans(across(ends_with("_DPSC"), ~log2(. + 1)))) %>%
  inner_join(rna_DPSC_vs_iN %>% select(gene_name_unique, status), by = "gene_name_unique") %>% 
  select(gene_name_unique, status, log2_mean_iN, log2_mean_Native)

colours <- c("Upregulated" = "firebrick3", "Downregulated" = "steelblue", "Insignificant" = "black")

labels <- sapply(names(colours), function(level) {
  num_genes <- rna_DPSC_vs_iN %>% filter(status == level) %>% nrow()
  label <- paste(level, "(", num_genes, ")", sep = "")
})
colour_scale <- scale_colour_manual(name = NULL, labels = labels, values = colours)

plot_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=log2_mean_Native, y=log2_mean_iN, colour=status)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = plot_data %>% filter(status != "Insignificant"), size = 0.8) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  colour_scale +
  labs(x = "log2(mean DPSC)",
       y = "log2(mean NCAM1+ iN)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11))

ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "svg", sep = "."), height = plot_height, width = plot_width)
ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "png", sep = "."), device = "png", height = plot_height, width = plot_width, limitsize = FALSE, dpi = 320, bg = "white")
```

## GO ORA Plots
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(plots_dir, "Bulk_RNAseq_DPSC_iN_GO_ORA_plot", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 6
plot_width <- 10

p1 <- rna_DPSC_vs_iN_ora_up@result %>%
  slice_min(p.adjust, n = 10) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(gene_ratio = sapply(strsplit(as.character(GeneRatio), "/"),
                     function(x) as.numeric(x[1])/as.numeric(x[2])),
         Description = str_wrap(Description, width = 30)) %>% 
  select(Description, gene_ratio, Count, p.adjust) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = gene_ratio, y = reorder(Description, gene_ratio))) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = p.adjust, size = Count), shape = 21) +
  scale_fill_gradient(high = "gray94", low = "firebrick1", limits = c(0, 0.01), labels = scales::label_scientific(digits = 2)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.05, 0.1), limits = c(0, 0.1)) +
  scale_size(range = c(0, 10), limits = c(25, 250)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "Gene Ratio",
       size = "Gene Count",
       fill = "Adj. p value")

p2 <- rna_DPSC_vs_iN_ora_down@result %>%
  slice_min(p.adjust, n = 10) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(gene_ratio = sapply(strsplit(as.character(GeneRatio), "/"),
                     function(x) as.numeric(x[1])/as.numeric(x[2])),
         Description = str_wrap(Description, width = 30)) %>% 
  select(Description, gene_ratio, Count, p.adjust) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = gene_ratio, y = reorder(Description, gene_ratio))) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = p.adjust, size = Count), shape = 21) +
  scale_fill_gradient(high = "gray94", low = "firebrick1", limits = c(0, 0.01), labels = scales::label_scientific(digits = 2)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.05, 0.1), limits = c(0, 0.1)) +
  scale_size(range = c(0, 10), limits = c(25, 250)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "Gene Ratio",
       size = "Gene Count",
       fill = "Adj. p value")

p1 + p2 + plot_layout(guides = "collect")

ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "svg", sep = "."), height = plot_height, width = plot_width)
ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "png", sep = "."), device = "png", height = plot_height, width = plot_width, limitsize = FALSE, dpi = 320, bg = "white")
```

## Reactome Network Plot - Upregulated genes
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(plots_dir, "Bulk_RNAseq_DPSC_iN_React_up_plot", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 12
plot_width <- 12

selected_terms <- c("R-HSA-112316", "R-HSA-112315", "R-HSA-112314", "R-HSA-983712", "R-HSA-1296071",  "R-HSA-6794362")

plot_data <- rna_DPSC_vs_iN_react_up
plot_data@result <- rna_DPSC_vs_iN_react_up@result %>% 
  filter(ID %in% selected_terms)

plot <- clusterProfiler::cnetplot(plot_data, color_category= "firebrick", color_item = "steelblue", node_label = "gene")
  
plot + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11)) +
  ggraph::geom_node_text(aes(label = name), fontface = "bold", size = 4,
                 data = subset(plot$data, .isCategory))

ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "svg", sep = "."), height = plot_height, width = plot_width)
ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "png", sep = "."), device = "png", height = plot_height, width = plot_width, limitsize = FALSE, dpi = 320, bg = "white")
```


## Heatmap - Major Markers
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(plots_dir, "Bulk_RNAseq_Major_Markers_Heatmap", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 14
plot_width <- 5
cell_dim <- 12

annotation_col <- metadata %>% 
  select(sample_id_new, cell_type, age) %>% 
  arrange(cell_type, sample_id_new) %>% 
  rename("Cell Line" = "cell_type",
         "Age" = "age") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("sample_id_new")

annotation_row <- broad_category_markers %>% 
  arrange(Category) %>% 
  filter(Genes %in% rna_DPSC_vs_iN_filt$gene_name) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("Genes")

gaps_row <- cumsum(table(annotation_row$Category))

exp_mat <- rna_exp_norm %>% 
  filter(gene_name %in% rownames(annotation_row)) %>% 
  mutate(gene_name = factor(gene_name, levels = rownames(annotation_row))) %>%
  arrange(gene_name) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "gene_name_unique") %>% 
  rename_with(.cols = names(sample_name_map_new), ~ as.character(sample_name_map_new[.])) %>% 
  select(rownames(annotation_col))

scale_colours <- rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))
  scale_colours <- colorRampPalette(scale_colours)(100)
  
pheatmap::pheatmap(mat = exp_mat, annotation_col = annotation_col, annotation_row = annotation_row, scale = "row", color = scale_colours, cluster_cols = FALSE, cluster_rows = FALSE, angle_col = 45, gaps_row = gaps_row, gaps_col = c(4), filename = paste0(plot_name, ".png"), cellwidth = cell_dim, cellheight = cell_dim, height = plot_height, width = plot_width)

pheatmap::pheatmap(mat = exp_mat, annotation_col = annotation_col, annotation_row = annotation_row, scale = "row", color = scale_colours, cluster_cols = FALSE, cluster_rows = FALSE, angle_col = 45, gaps_row = gaps_row, gaps_col = c(4), filename = paste0(plot_name, ".pdf"), cellwidth = cell_dim, cellheight = cell_dim, height = plot_height, width = plot_width)
```

# MS Proteomic Data 
## PCA Plot
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(plots_dir, "MS_Prot_PCA_plot", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 8 
plot_width <- 12 

ms_pca <- ms_data_tmt_human_only_filt_log2 %>% 
  column_to_rownames("accession") %>% 
  select(matches("^D[0-9]+_(DPSC|iN)")) %>% 
  mutate(row_var = matrixStats::rowVars(as.matrix(.))) %>%  
  slice_max(row_var, n = 500) %>% 
  select(-row_var) %>% 
  t() %>% 
  prcomp(., center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

percentVar <- round(100 * (ms_pca$sdev^2 / sum(ms_pca$sdev^2))[1:2])

ms_pca <- as.data.frame(ms_pca$x) %>% 
  mutate(sample_id = rownames(.)) %>% 
  inner_join(metadata, by = "sample_id")

ms_pca %>% 
  ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2, color = cell_type, label = sample_id_new)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = sample_id_new), size = 10/2.845, box.padding = 0.5, max.overlaps = 100) + 
  labs(x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance"),
       y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance"),
       shape = "Cell Culture",
       color = "Donor") +
  theme_light() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11))

ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "svg", sep = "."), device = "svg", width = plot_width, height = plot_height)
ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "png", sep = "."), device = "png", height = plot_height, width = plot_width, limitsize = FALSE, dpi = 320, bg = "white")
```

## Mean Plot
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(plots_dir, "MS_Prot_DPSC_iN_Mean_plot", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 7
plot_width <- 7

plot_data <- ms_data_tmt_human_only_filt_log2 %>% 
  mutate(log2_mean_iN = rowMeans(across(ends_with("_iN"))), 
         log2_mean_Native = rowMeans(across(ends_with("_DPSC")))) %>%
  inner_join(ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma %>% select(accession, logFC, adj.P.Val, status), by = "accession") %>% 
  select(accession, status, log2_mean_iN, log2_mean_Native, -logFC, -adj.P.Val)

colours <- c("Upregulated" = "firebrick3", "Downregulated" = "steelblue", "Insignificant" = "black")

labels <- sapply(names(colours), function(level) {
  num_proteins <- ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma %>% filter(status == level) %>% nrow()
  label <- paste(level, "(", num_proteins, ")", sep = "")
})
colour_scale <- scale_colour_manual(name = NULL, labels = labels, values = colours)

plot_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=log2_mean_Native, y=log2_mean_iN, colour=status)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = plot_data %>% filter(status != "Insignificant"), size = 0.8) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  colour_scale +
  labs(x = "log2(mean DPSC)",
       y = "log2(mean iN)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11))

ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "svg", sep = "."), height = plot_height, width = plot_width)
ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "png", sep = "."), device = "png", height = plot_height, width = plot_width, limitsize = FALSE, dpi = 320, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
  column_to_rownames("sample_id_new")

annotation_row <- broad_category_markers %>% 
  arrange(Category) %>% 
  filter(Genes %in% ms_data_tmt_human_only_diff_analysis_results_limma_filt$gene_name) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("Genes")

exp_mat <- ms_data_tmt_human_only_filt_log2 %>% 
  filter(gene_name %in% rownames(annotation_row)) %>% 
  mutate(gene_name = factor(gene_name, levels = rownames(annotation_row))) %>%
  arrange(gene_name) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "gene_name") %>% 
  rename_with(.cols = names(sample_name_map_new), ~ as.character(sample_name_map_new[.])) %>% 
  select(rownames(annotation_col))

  scale_colours <- colorRampPalette(scale_colours)(100)
  
pheatmap::pheatmap(mat = exp_mat, annotation_col = annotation_col, annotation_row = annotation_row, scale = "row", color = scale_colours, cluster_cols = FALSE, cluster_rows = FALSE, angle_col = 45, gaps_row = gaps_row, gaps_col = c(4), filename = paste0(plot_name, ".png"), cellwidth = cell_dim, cellheight = cell_dim, height = plot_height, width = plot_width)
```

## Box Plots - Selected OXYPHOS Proteins
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(plots_dir, "MS_Prot_OXYPHOS_BoxPlot", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 4
plot_width <- 5

genes <- c("MT-ATP6", "SLC25A12", "NDUFC2", "ATP5MC3", "COX20")

plot_data <- ms_data_tmt_human_only_filt_log2 %>%
  filter(gene_name %in% genes) %>% 
  select(gene_name, names(sample_name_map_new)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "norm_counts", cols = names(sample_name_map_new)) %>% 
  inner_join(metadata %>% select(sample_id, cell_type, donor_id), by = join_by("sample_id"))

for (gene_sym in unique(plot_data$gene_name)) {
  sub_plot_name <- paste(plot_name, gene_sym, sep = "_")
  
  plot_data %>% 
    filter(gene_name == gene_sym) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = cell_type, y = norm_counts)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(colour = cell_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(group = donor_id), color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.7) +
  labs(title = gene_sym,
       x = "Cell Line",
       y = "Normalized Abundance") +
  theme_classic() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme(legend.position="none",
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11)) 

  ggsave(filename = paste(sub_plot_name,
                        "svg",
                        sep = "."),
       height = plot_height,
       width = plot_width,
       limitsize = F)

ggsave(filename = paste(sub_plot_name,
                        "png",
                        sep = "."),
       device = "png",
       dpi = 320,
       height = plot_height,
       width = plot_width,
       limitsize = FALSE)
}
```

# DNAm Array Data
## PCA plot - based on top 500 promoter-genes
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(plots_dir, "DNAm_PCA_plot", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 8 
plot_width <- 12

dnam_pca <- prcomp(t(m_values_exp[order(matrixStats::rowVars(as.matrix(m_values_exp)), decreasing = TRUE)[1:500],]), center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

percentVar <- round(100 * (dnam_pca$sdev^2 / sum(dnam_pca$sdev^2))[1:2])

dnam_pca <- as.data.frame(dnam_pca$x) %>% 
  mutate(sample_id = rownames(.)) %>% 
  inner_join(metadata, by = "sample_id")

dnam_pca %>% 
  ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2, color = cell_type, label = sample_id_new)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = sample_id_new), size = 10/2.845, box.padding = 0.5, max.overlaps = 100) + 
  labs(x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance"),
       y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance"),
       shape = "Cell Culture",
       color = "Donor") +
  theme_light() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11))

ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "svg", sep = "."), device = "svg", width = plot_width, height = plot_height)
ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "png", sep = "."), device = "png", width = plot_width, height = plot_height, dpi = 320, limitsize = FALSE, bg = "white")
```


### PCA plot - based on top 500 promoter-genes - with limma correction
```{r}
# dnam_pca <- as.data.frame(temp) %>%

temp <- temp[complete.cases(temp),]
temp <- temp[order(matrixStats::rowVars(as.matrix(temp)), decreasing = TRUE)[1:500],]
dnam_pca <- prcomp(t(temp), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

percentVar <- round(100 * (dnam_pca$sdev^2 / sum(dnam_pca$sdev^2))[1:2])

dnam_pca <- as.data.frame(dnam_pca$x) %>% 
  mutate(sample_id = rownames(.)) %>% 
  inner_join(metadata, by = "sample_id")

dnam_pca %>% 
  ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2, color = cell_type, label = sample_id_new)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = sample_id_new), size = 10/2.845, box.padding = 0.5, max.overlaps = 100) + 
  labs(x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance"),
       y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance"),
       shape = "Cell Culture",
       color = "Donor") +
  theme_light() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11))
```
## Volcano Plot
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(plots_dir, "DNAm_DPSC_iN_Volcano_plot", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 7 
plot_width <- 10

volcano_data <- dnam_dmr_ann %>% 
  mutate(log10P = -log10(adj.P.Val))

colours <- c("Hypermethylated" = "#D62728", "Hypomethylated" = "#1F77B4", "Insignificant" = "gray70")

labels <- sapply(names(colours), function(level) {
  num_genes <- dnam_dmr_ann %>% filter(status == level) %>% nrow()
  label <- paste(level, "(", num_genes, ")", sep = "")
})

colour_scale <- scale_colour_manual(name = NULL, labels = labels, values = colours)
  
ggplot(volcano_data, aes(x = logFC, y = log10P)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = status), size = 2) +
  geom_point(data = subset(volcano_data, status != "Insignificant"),
             aes(color = status), size = 2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  colour_scale +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 11)) +
  labs(colour = "Change in Abdundance",
        x = "logFC iN/DPSC",
        y = "-log10(Adj. p-value)")

ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "svg", sep = "."), device = "svg", width = plot_width, height = plot_height)
ggsave(filename = paste(plot_name, "png", sep = "."), device = "png", width = plot_width, height = plot_height, dpi = 320, limitsize = FALSE, bg = "white")
```

## Heatmap - Differentially Methylated Promoters
```{r}
plot_name <- paste(plots_dir, "DNAm_DMR_DPSC_iN_Heatmap", sep = "/")
plot_height <- 9
plot_width <- 9
cell_dim <- 12

annotation_col <- metadata %>% 
  select(sample_id_new, cell_type, age) %>% 
  arrange(cell_type, sample_id_new) %>% 
  rename("Cell Line" = "cell_type",
         "Age" = "age") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("sample_id_new")

annotation_row <- left_join(dnam_dmr_ann_filt, rna_DPSC_vs_iN %>% select(gene_id, status), by = "gene_id") %>% 
  mutate("RNA Exp: NCAM1+ iN vs DPSC" = ifelse(is.na(status.y), "Not Found", as.character(status.y)),
         "RNA Exp: NCAM1+ iN vs DPSC" = factor(`RNA Exp: NCAM1+ iN vs DPSC`, levels = c("Upregulated", "Downregulated", "Insignificant", "Not Found"))) %>% 
  rename("DNAm Exp: iN vs DPSC" = "status.x",
         "# CpGs" = "n_cpgs") %>% 
  select(gene_name, `# CpGs`, `RNA Exp: NCAM1+ iN vs DPSC`, `DNAm Exp: iN vs DPSC`) %>% 
  arrange(`RNA Exp: NCAM1+ iN vs DPSC`) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("gene_name")

gaps_row <- cumsum(table(annotation_row[["RNA Exp: NCAM1+ iN vs DPSC"]]))

exp_mat <- m_values_filt_ann_aggr_promoters_per_gene %>% 
  filter(gene_name %in% rownames(annotation_row)) %>%
  mutate(gene_name = factor(gene_name, levels = rownames(annotation_row))) %>%
  arrange(gene_name) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "gene_name") %>% 
  rename_with(.cols = names(sample_name_map_new), ~ as.character(sample_name_map_new[.])) %>% 
  select(rownames(annotation_col))

scale_colours <- rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))
  scale_colours <- colorRampPalette(scale_colours)(100)
  
pheatmap::pheatmap(mat = exp_mat, annotation_col = annotation_col, annotation_row = annotation_row, scale = "row", color = scale_colours, cluster_cols = FALSE, cluster_rows = FALSE, angle_col = 45, gaps_row = gaps_row, filename = paste0(plot_name, ".png"), cellwidth = cell_dim, cellheight = cell_dim, height = plot_height, width = plot_width)

pheatmap::pheatmap(mat = exp_mat, annotation_col = annotation_col, annotation_row = annotation_row, scale = "row", color = scale_colours, cluster_cols = FALSE, cluster_rows = FALSE, angle_col = 45, gaps_row = gaps_row, filename = paste0(plot_name, ".pdf"), cellwidth = cell_dim, cellheight = cell_dim, height = plot_height, width = plot_width)
```
